home.title: Know in advance which hours will be expensive
home.subtitle: Forecasts of the Greek Day-Ahead Market price, published before the auction closes. For biogas, solar, wind and small hydro plants.
home.feature1Body: The next-day forecast is published before the bidding gate closes (12:00 CET), together with an indicative 7-day outlook.
home.feature2Body: Not just a single line: see the likely price range (P10–P90) and the hours with zero or negative prices.
home.feature3Body: For biogas plants we suggest when to produce, based on your gas storage and your engines' constraints.
